Investigator Study · Seoul 2026

1927-nm Fractional Thulium Laser Followed by Topical PYDERIN PDRN for Facial Photoaging

n=26 completed, three sessions. At week 12: photoaging score −36%, pore size −27%, pigmented area −28% (all p<0.001). 73.1% rated good-to-excellent; zero post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation.
